CompositeOT.options¶

Validated solver option containers for CompositeOT.

The dataclasses are intentionally plain so users can write, for example, PALMOptions(max_iterations=50, tolerance=1e-7) and pass the result directly to problem.solve. Validation is run by the solvers, not at construction time, so options remain easy to build and modify with dataclasses.replace.

Classes

ADMMOptions([max_iterations, penalty, ...])

Controls for the first-order ADMM solver.

PALMOptions([max_iterations, sigma, tau, ...])

Controls for the ripALM outer solver.

SemismoothNewtonOptions([max_iterations, ...])

Controls for the damped semismooth Newton subproblem solve.
